intent: 暗紫色的星云状流动背景，缓慢演化，带少量颗粒感

dark purple/violet palette, dark overall (background-grade luminance)

Two misses: the grain is far from '少量/subtle' — coarse noise dominates every pixel and competes with the cloud read (Lightness 60 renders much stronger than the intended 6%); and overall luminance is mid-bright in large areas, above background grade for 暗紫色.
